jobs.prompt: tests/board-card-ui.test.mjs fails 2 tests on Node 20.19 (this machine; CI runs Node 20 and 22): 'need-you list opens ... copy' and 'ready list opens ... copy' get 0 clipboard writes. The fake DOM stubs win.navigator.clipboard (~lines 159-175), but tools/watch-assets/board.js copyCommandButton calls the global `navigator`, which on Node 20 is not the stub (and on Node 22 is a read-only getter). Make the stub reach the global on every Node version: save the original property descriptor of globalThis.navigator, then Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'navigator', { value: win.navigator, configurable: true, writable: true }) for the test and restore the original descriptor in an after/finally hook. Do not change board.js. Verify locally with `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-card-ui.test.mjs` (must be 0 failures) and with the whole board set: `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-*.test.mjs`.
